##Setup
```{r setup}
library(magick)
library(ImageFilter)
```

## Load your image into a bitmap
```{r "load_image"}

my_image <- image_read("../test-image1.jpg") #replace with the your image pathway
bitmap_image <- my_image[[1]]
image_read(bitmap_image)
```

## Apply filter
```{r "Grey filter"}
## Grey filter
grey_image <- pixel_scanner(bitmap_image, grey_filter)
image_read(grey_image)
```

```{r "Red filter"}
##Red filter
red_image <- pixel_scanner(bitmap_image, red_filter)
image_read(red_image)
```

```{r "Green filter"}
##Green filter
green_image <- pixel_scanner(bitmap_image, green_filter)
image_read(green_image)
```

```{r "Blue filter"}
##Blue filter
blue_image <- pixel_scanner(bitmap_image, blue_filter)
image_read(blue_image)
```

## Adjusting the threshold
```{r "threshold"}
#can be applied to any other filter as well, with a threshold between 0-255
my_red_low <- function(pixel) red_filter(pixel, threshold = 20)
result_low <- pixel_scanner(bitmap_image, my_red_low)
image_read(result_low)
```
